# OpusApplication

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Opus` · enum

```csharp
public enum OpusApplication
```

What an Opus encoder is tuned for.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="audio"></a>`Audio` | Music and general audio: the most faithful (OPUS_APPLICATION_AUDIO). |
| <a name="voip"></a>`Voip` | Speech: the most intelligible (OPUS_APPLICATION_VOIP). |
| <a name="restrictedlowdelay"></a>`RestrictedLowDelay` | The lowest delay: CELT only (OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_LOWDELAY). |
| <a name="restrictedsilk"></a>`RestrictedSilk` | SILK only, for speech decoders that have nothing else (OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_SILK). |
| <a name="restrictedcelt"></a>`RestrictedCelt` | CELT only, with the usual delay (OPUS_APPLICATION_RESTRICTED_CELT). |
